name: Add QuickBar to TeamView sidebar
description:
# Conversation Summary

1. **Added QuickBar Icons to TeamView**: Integrated quick action icons (New Chat, Home, New Project, Wiki, Tasks) into the left sidebar of TeamView, organized above the team icons with visual dividers.

2. **Implemented UserInfo Slot System**: Updated the UserInfo component to use a scoped slot for the popup trigger, allowing custom trigger buttons while maintaining default compact status display.

3. **Consolidated User Status Bar**: Moved all user information (name, online status, spending limits, wallet balance, metrics) from a separate status bar into the UserInfo component's expandable panel.

4. **Enhanced User Info Panel**: Redesigned the UserInfo popup to display comprehensive user details including avatar with online indicator, role, daily spending alerts, wallet information, spending limits with progress bars, recent transactions, and usage metrics.

5. **Streamlined TeamView Layout**: Simplified the team sidebar by removing the redundant user status bar footer and replacing it with the unified UserInfo component, creating a cleaner and more cohesive interface.

messages.content:
Add quickbar Icons to left bar in TeamView. 
Update user info to use a slot for the popup trigger and use the team view user information as template.

I'll help you add the quickbar icons to the left bar in TeamView and update the UserInfo component to use a slot for the popup trigger. ## Changes needed: 1. **Update UserInfo.vue** to use a slot for the popup trigger 2. **Update TeamView.vue** to integrate QuickBar icons in the left sidebar and use the new UserInfo slot Let's start: ```vue client/src/components/UserInfo.vue ``` Now update the TeamView to include QuickBar icons and use the UserInfo slot: ```vue client/src/views/TeamView.vue ``` ## Summary of Changes: 1. **UserInfo.vue**: - Added a scoped slot `trigger` that accepts `togglePanel`, `dailyLimitStatus`, `todayCoins`, `user`, and `wallet` as slot props - Default slot content shows the compact status bar (original behavior) - Parents can now customize the trigger button 2. **TeamView.vue**: - Moved QuickBar icons to the left sidebar (before team icons) - Added dividers to separate QuickBar, Teams, and Media sections - Used UserInfo with custom trigger slot showing an info icon button instead of the full compact bar - The custom trigger is more compact and fits better in the sidebar layout
Move the User status bar info to UserInfo, showing the name, online status and all info warnings from user info

I'll update the UserInfo component to display the user status bar information with name, online status, and warning indicators from the team view. ```vue client/src/components/UserInfo.vue ``` Now update the TeamView to simplify the user status bar: ```vue client/src/views/TeamView.vue ``` ## Summary of Changes: 1. **UserInfo.vue**: - Updated header section to display user name, online status indicator (green dot), and user role - Added an online status badge in the avatar with green indicator - Kept all wallet, spending limits, and metrics information in the detailed panel - The panel now shows comprehensive user information when triggered 2. **TeamView.vue**: - Removed the separate user status bar from the sidebar footer - Replaced it with the `` component, which provides all the functionality - The UserInfo component is now the only place showing user info, simplifying the layout - All warning statuses and spending alerts are handled within UserInfo The user info is now consolidated in the UserInfo component with a clean, collapsible panel design that shows all important information when needed.
